thread:
sam: Quick idea for the SI onboarding pilot: make it gamified via microbadges to speed up self-serve adoption. Small wins, visible progress, and instant Bronze plumbing. Thoughts? :sparkles:
yvonne: I like that. Microbadges make it tangible. Suggest 4 baseline microbadges: marketplace-ready, routing-expert, private-deploy, performance-tuned. Each with 2-3 lightweight checks.
diego: Agree. Keep checks automatable where possible so Bronze can be almost instant. Example: marketplace-ready = [profile_complete, nda_signed, smoke_deploy_artifact].
meera: Also add a social/visibility element: show microbadges on partner profile and let SEs endorse badges after walkthroughs. Endorsements = stronger signal for listings.
sam: Proposal: two badge classes — microbadges (auto/semi-auto) and milestone badges (Bronze/Silver/Gold). Milestones depend on microbadge counts + required artifacts.
yvonne: Nice. Milestone rules idea:
```
milestone_rules:
  bronze: requires [marketplace-ready] OR 2 microbadges + auto_checks_pass
  silver: requires [bronze, routing-expert, live_walkthrough_minutes:30]
  gold: requires [silver, production_pilot_signed, reference_confirmed]
```
diego: For automation we need API endpoints: POST /partners/<id>/badges with evidence, HMAC signature from SE or system. badge-bot can validate and issue. Also need audit log linkage.
meera: For partner UX, show a progress bar and a checklist they can click to upload artifacts. Keep each microbadge process under 20 minutes on average.
sam: Telemetry and billing: add tags on evidence upload: si_cohort, badge_id, evidence_id, hw_loan_id (if present). Marketplace should filter partners by badges and microbadges. marketplace-bot: Noted. Will add fields: microbadges[], milestone_badge, public_badge_visible.
yvonne: Governance: Bronze auto-issue only if evidence URLs are present and auto-tests pass. Silver requires SE JWT approval. Gold requires manual signoff by partnerships+legal. Also retention: keep evidence for 90 days for Bronze, 365 for Silver/Gold.
diego: Quick curl example for automation:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/partners/6789/badges"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SYSTEM_TOKEN"
  -H "X-HMAC: $HMAC"
  -d '{"badge_id":"performance-tuned","evidence":["https://s3.../perf.pdf"]}'
```
meera: Action items: 1) Sam to write microbadge catalog (list + checks) and UX mockups (ETA Thu); 2) Diego to add badge API spec + HMAC validation (ETA Fri); 3) Yvonne to draft milestone mapping and retention policy (ETA Fri); 4) marketplace-bot to add listing fields + filter support (ETA Mon). badge-bot: Created ticket REDWOOD-SI-7700 "Microbadge onboarding pilot + milestone mapping" -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-SI-7700
sam: Pilot plan: run with 6 marketplace-first SIs next month. Measure: time-to-bronze, number of self-serve completions, and conversion to Silver. If positive, roll to cohort onboarding.
yvonne: Also run a small A/B: show progress bar vs no progress bar to see lift. Diego: I'll wire a telemetry tag for that A/B too.
diego: Noted. Telemetry keys: ab_test_progress_ui, si_cohort, badge_count, time_to_bronze_ms.
sam: Great. We'll reconvene next Tue for draft catalog review. Thanks team. :rocket:
